Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Pawnesh Tiwari,Dr. D.K. Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.

Learned counsel for the applicant is permitted to implead husband namely Sharandu Shukla, S/o Ravi Dutt Shukla, R/o Badhumar (Chamanganj), Police Station Antoo, district Pratapgarh as applicant no. 2 during the course of the day.
Heard learned Counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material on record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants for quashing the criminal proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1506 of 2019 (State vs. Sardendu Shukla & others),
arising out of Case Crime No. 158 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 406 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Prayagraj, pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.) / F.T.C., Court No. 21, Allahabad.

opennyai_summary.facts:
After argument at some length, learned Counsel for the applicants has submitted that since it is a matrimonial dispute, there is chance of amicable settlement of dispute outside the Court.
1 further submitted that the case may be sent to Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Allahabad High Court for taking an effort for settlement between the parties.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In view of above submissions made by learned Counsel for the applicants, it is directed that applicants will deposit Rs. 20,000/- within fifteen days from today through bank draft in favour of Registrar Accounts Allahabad High Court, Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
In case, the aforesaid amount is deposited, the notice shall be issued to opposite party no.2.
Rs.
18,000/- out of the aforementioned deposited amount shall be paid to opposite party no.2 after conclusion of mediation proceedings and remaining amount of Rs. 2000/- is payable to Mediation and Conciliation Centre, Allahabad High Court.
Mediation Centre is expected to conclude its proceedings within three months.
List after three months along with report of Mediation Centre before appropriate Bench.
This case shall not be treated as part heard/tied up to this Bench.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
It is made clear that if the applicants fail to deposit the money within ten days or avoids in participating in the mediation proceedings or delays the proceedings, then coercive measure shall be taken against them as required.
